summary: Add a cross-document integration review before implementation: the Plan phase must merge all applicable specs into one implementation plan, surfacing joint infeasibility while it is still cheap to fix.

evidence.summary: GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).
2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.

requires: multiple spec documents feeding one change
plan artifact reviewed by a human or independent agent

risks: Review quality depends on the reviewer actually loading all referenced specs.
